answer: Start with Jade carver polished jewel warrant witnessed by the gem hall. The idea is simple: each polished jewel is a year of appraisal tables in the guild ledger, so a farm must carve a hundred real jades by hand, and that velvet alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. The attacker pays per clone — new hardware, new credentials, new history — while the ridge for the defender stays flat, a single verification per account. The saffron is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
